title: 太空望遠鏡找到最遙遠的類星體
paras: Astronomers have found the most distant quasar ever seen. A quasar is the bright center of a galaxy, powered by a giant black hole that pulls in gas and dust. As the material falls in, it heats up and gives off huge amounts of light. This new quasar was already shining about 630 million years after the Big Bang, when the universe was less than five percent of its current age of 13.8 billion years.

The discovery was made with Euclid, a space telescope run by the European Space Agency. A team led by Julien Wolf of the European Southern Observatory announced the result on November 24. Other telescopes, including Hubble and Webb, helped confirm it. Earlier records moved the limit back by about 15 million years each time, but this one moves it back by almost 40 million years.

Measurements from Webb show that the black hole at its center has the mass of about 360 million suns. Scientists still do not fully understand how such a heavy object could form so soon after the universe began. Wolf says the new record might be broken again within months, or it might last for years.

vocab.zh: 類星體（由巨大黑洞發光的星系核心）

options: A giant black hole that pulls in gas and dust
A group of very young stars
A planet close to the galaxy
Light that comes from our sun
questions.why: 第一段：類星體的能量來自巨大的黑洞，黑洞把氣體和塵埃吸進去，物質變熱後發出大量的光。

options: A telescope on a mountain in Taiwan
questions.why: 第二段：發現是用歐洲太空總署的 Euclid 望遠鏡做的，Hubble 和 Webb 是幫忙確認。

questions.q: Why is this new record special?
options: It is the first quasar that people have ever found
It moves the limit back by almost 40 million years, much more than earlier records
It is the quasar closest to Earth
Its black hole is smaller than our sun
questions.why: 第二段：以前每次破紀錄大約往前推 1500 萬年，這次一口氣往前推了將近 4000 萬年。
